prayerExcerpt.en-US: And your own soul a sword will pierce.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Uma espada traspassará tua própria alma.

meta.face: Our Lady as in recurring-figures.md, matured to about forty-eight (the same woman, not a different face): a delicate, softly OVAL face — a smooth high forehead, a fine straight nose with a narrow bridge, almond-shaped brown eyes under gently arched light-brown brows, softly rounded cheeks now a little thinner, faint lines at the eyes, a small rosy mouth, a small rounded chin; light-brown hair parted in the centre, under a white veil and violet-blue mantle; her eyes raised a little toward heaven in quiet grief, sorrowful but serene.
meta.basis: The seven swords piercing Mary's heart, from Simeon's prophecy (Luke 2:35) and the Servite devotion of the Seven Sorrows, are the title's own image; the empty cross with the linen recalls the Stabat Mater. Our Lady keeps the set's face, matured.

sources.title: Catholic Encyclopedia (1910): Seven Sorrows of the Blessed Virgin Mary
